conventions.arithmetic: Decimal precision 50; unrounded intermediate products; final money ROUND_HALF_UP to 0.01
conventions.interpretation: Hypothetical assumptions, not predicted or realized savings; one pool only; never sum overlapping scenarios
conventions.money: GBP; nonnegative inputs with at most two decimal places; no implicit VAT adjustment
conventions.period: Same selected reporting period; no annualization or assumed recurrence
conventions.rates: Percent units 0–100 inclusive; at most four decimal places
conventions.roi: Rounded net benefit / total costs × 100, rounded HALF_UP to four percentage decimals; unavailable at zero cost
